Works rows lack interactive semantics: non-current rows are focusable divs with keyboard activation but no button/link role
Filesystem navigation is non-portable: window.open(new URL(relativePath, location.href)) resolves source-local paths
Document language metadata mismatch: A/B declare <html lang="ko"> while the primary interface/body copy is substantially English
Reduced-motion desktop cursor visibility: base .scroll-spacer uses cursor:none; the reduced-motion media query hides the custom .cursor

Host bridge intercepts window.open and routes through fail-closed repository portal ledger (HOLD targets never navigate)
Host bridge adds role=dialog, aria-modal, focus trap, background inert to WORKS overlay
Host bridge adds role=button to non-current WORKS rows
Host bridge pauses RAF choreography when prefers-reduced-motion is active
Host bridge restores visible cursor for reduced-motion desktop fine pointers
